run_megadepth_conversion: run the megadepth conversion script to process MegaDepth scenes into WAI format with depth maps and poses
process_megadepth_scene: process a single MegaDepth scene by converting H5 depth maps to EXR and saving WAI metadata
load_kpts_and_poses: load camera intrinsics, poses, and 3D point indices from COLMAP sparse reconstruction files
convert_colmap_pose_to_RT: convert a COLMAP raw pose quaternion to a rotation matrix and translation vector
convert_colmap_pose_to_principal_axis: convert a COLMAP raw pose quaternion to its principal Z-axis direction vector
